dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped light-gray annuli with diffuse exterior-to-interior gradients; perimeter geometry is irregular and soft-edged. Prominent structures include a large elliptical annulus in the central-lateral region and a chain of three smaller circular annuli posterior to the mid-flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of light-gray amorphous pixel clusters in the anterior dorsal region; central-lateral region exhibits discrete low-intensity (dark) core blobs contained within high-contrast ring perimeters.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three primary mid-lateral annuli form an elongated, obtuse triangular configuration roughly parallel to the dorsal-lateral midline.
